test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A certain number of people are sitting in a row and facing north. U is sitting 4th to the right of S. V is sitting 5th from the right end. V is seated at the immediate right of U. If no other person is sitting in the row, what is the total number of persons seated?
solution:
A certain number of people are sitting in a row and facing north.

1) V is sitting 5th from the right end.

2) V is seated at the immediate right of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff1bba0c617ffa06c8d806aa3d1952ef2c081b77e8f2c39d9c2a4f6d83b724ae.png] 

3) U is sitting 4th to the right of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7126745d7fd23fe77170c46abe5dcc7b5b6f6d4b2a56471b918033a55271321.png] 

If no other person is sitting in the row, so, **10** is the total number of persons seated.

Hence, the correct answer is **"10".**
